newsitem.title: USA: CBOT new crop soy up sharply on oversold ideas.
newsitem.headline: CBOT new crop soy up sharply on oversold ideas.

text.p: CBOT new crop soybeans were sharply higher early Tuesday on a technical bounce, traders said.
"We're severely oversold," said one trader. "We're long overdue for a bounce."
The deferred soybean months posted fresh contract lows on Monday and were primed to bounce back, traders said.
At 0959 CDT, November soybeans were 7-1/4 cents per bushel higher at $6.60, and other months were steady to nine cents higher.
